correctness.rationale: For arbitrary finite E, the norm ratio of hereditary source and target set-sum norms equals the finite LP maximizing ∑w_v subject to ∑_{v∈F}w_v≤1; finite strong duality gives minimum fractional F cover. For graph clique F, independent sets of complement H give χ_f(H[E]). Bounded identity has inverse norm exactly 1 by singleton/ℓ1 domination and density, hence onto. χ_f≤2 forbids odd cycle because uniform dual weights 1/m on 2m+1-cycle yield 2+1/m; no odd cycle iff bipartite even on uncountable components. The block construction makes G a complete join of repeated intersecting-k-set graphs, complement disjoint union KG(floor(ck),k), with additive block norm. EKR gives exact ratio n_k/k via uniform vector, random-star lower bound for all coefficients, and Lovász–Kneser gives χ(H)=ℵ0. Sup floor(ck)/k=c. Independent finite LP checked C5=2.5, K3=3, edge+isolate=2; finite checks are corroboration, not uncountable proof.
